Name: Sanballat
Summary: Horonite governor of Samaria who mocked, threatened, and plotted against Nehemiah's wall at every stage.
KeyVerses: Nehemiah 2:10; Nehemiah 2:19; Nehemiah 4:1; Nehemiah 4:7; Nehemiah 6:1; Nehemiah 6:2; Nehemiah 6:5; Nehemiah 6:12; Nehemiah 6:14; Nehemiah 13:28
LifeLesson: Mockery is often the first weapon against God's work.
